title: Choose the final product name and publish the package to npm
description: Owner decision 2026-11-08: after a usable version, pick a proper name and publish to the npm registry (currently @mmilad/pm, unpublished). Preferred name: heistman (a heist = planning and procurement for an undertaking; see docs/product-vision.md 'Planning philosophy'). Check npm/GitHub availability (pnpm view heistman → 404 means free), rename package and bin (heistman, maybe short alias), update README/LICENSE and add a release checklist.
